mapper.select: SELECT * FROM runs WHERE archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT question, answer FROM runs WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3
mapper.update: UPDATE runs SET status = #{run.status}, answer = #{run.answer}, error_code = #{run.errorCode}, finished_at = #{run.finishedAt}, elapsed_ms = #{run.elapsedMs} WHERE id = #{run.id} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE runs SET input_tokens = input_tokens + #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = output_tokens + #{outputTokens} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS runs, COUNT(DISTINCT r.session_id) AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_events e WHERE e.run_id = r.id AND e.kind = 'USAGE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unreported, COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.elapsed_ms), 0) AS elapsed_ms
FROM runs r WHERE r.created_at >= #{from} AND r.created_at < #{until}
mapper.select: SELECT SUBSTRING(r.created_at, 1, #{length}) AS group_id, '' AS question, GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY group_id
SELECT r.session_id AS group_id, MIN(r.question) AS question, GROUP BY r.session_id ORDER BY SUM(r.input_tokens + r.output_tokens) DESC, r.session_id LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM runs WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 50 OFFSET #{offset}
